fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 你好吗？欢迎回来 Lazy Chinese 听故事。
fullTextEN: How are you? Welcome back to Lazy Chinese to listen to stories.

fullTextZH: 有的时候你会不会心急？
fullTextEN: Do you sometimes get impatient?

fullTextZH: 心急就是你想要一个东西，
fullTextEN: Impatience is when you want something,
you want it quickly,
you want it now,
you want it immediately, you don't want to wait.
For example, you are learning Chinese,
you have studied for a week,
after a week,

fullTextZH: 你想要说很长很长的中文句子。
fullTextEN: you want to speak very long Chinese sentences.

fullTextZH: 或是你有一个新的工作，
fullTextEN: Or you have a new job,
after a month,

fullTextZH: 你想要你的老板给你更多钱。
fullTextEN: you want your boss to give you more money.
Things like this are all impatience.
Today, the story we are going to tell,

fullTextZH: 是关于一个特别心急的人。
fullTextEN: is about a particularly impatient person.
In ancient India,
there was a king.

fullTextZH: 国王20岁的时候没有孩子，
fullTextEN: When the king was 20 years old, he had no children,
At 30 years old, there were still no children,
At 40 years old, there were still no children,
What about at 50 years old?
Still no children.
What about at 60 years old?
At 60 years old, he had a daughter.
Because the king was very old,
He was very anxious.

fullTextZH: 他现在、马上要看女儿长大。
fullTextEN: He wanted to see his daughter grow up immediately.

fullTextZH: 所以国王叫他的大臣来，
fullTextEN: So the king called his ministers,

fullTextZH: 大臣就是帮国王做事的人。
fullTextEN: Ministers are people who help the king with tasks.

fullTextZH: 国王叫大臣来想一个办法，
fullTextEN: The king asked the ministers to come up with a solution,
to make his daughter grow up immediately.

fullTextZH: 这些大臣听到国王叫他们想办法，
fullTextEN: These ministers, upon hearing the king's request for a solution,
were all very troubled.
They thought the king was crazy,

fullTextZH: 怎么可能让小孩马上长大呢？
fullTextEN: How could it be possible to make a child grow up immediately?
It's impossible!
But you can tell the king:
King, you are crazy,
We have no way.
Can you say this?
No, you will die.
The king will cut off your head.

fullTextZH: 可是如果没有人想办法，
fullTextEN: But if no one thinks of a way,
The king will also be angry,
and will also cut off everyone's heads.

fullTextZH: 这个时候，有一个医生想了一个办法。
fullTextEN: At this time, a doctor thought of a way.
He told the king,
I know there is a kind of flower,
a special kind of flower,

fullTextZH: 公主吃了以后可以马上长大。
fullTextEN: After the princess eats it, she can grow up immediately.
But this kind of flower is very hard to find,
It is in a very far, very far place,
on a very high, very high mountain.
After I reach that place,
I can't pick the flower immediately,
I have to wait for the flower to bloom.

fullTextZH: 所以我需要很长很长的时间。
fullTextEN: So I need a very long time.
Can the king wait?

fullTextZH: 国王问医生：很长很长的时间是多久？
fullTextEN: The king asked the doctor: How long is a very long time?
The doctor said: 10 years or 15 years.

fullTextZH: 国王问：公主吃了这种花，
fullTextEN: The king asked: If the princess eats this kind of flower,
can she really grow up immediately?
The doctor said: Yes,
really.
But when the flower is found,
the princess must eat it immediately,

fullTextZH: 如果没有马上吃，花没有用。
fullTextEN: if she doesn't eat it immediately, the flower is useless.

fullTextZH: 所以我要带公主一起去。
fullTextEN: So I will take the princess with me.
The king said: Alas,

fullTextZH: 好吧，你带公主一起去找花吧。
fullTextEN: Alright, you take the princess to find the flower.

fullTextZH: 所以医生带着公主去很远很远的地方。
fullTextEN: So the doctor took the princess to a very far place.
The princess was not there,
The king did not see the princess,

fullTextZH: 他慢慢忘记这件事情了。
fullTextEN: He slowly forgot about this matter.
12 years later,
The doctor came back,
The doctor brought the princess back.
The king looked at the princess,

fullTextZH: 她现在不是一个小宝宝了，
fullTextEN: She's not a little baby anymore,

fullTextZH: 她现在是一个非常漂亮的女孩。
fullTextEN: She's now a very beautiful girl.
Wow, the king is very, very happy.
He gave the doctor a lot of money,
because the doctor found the flower,
to let the princess grow up immediately.

fullTextZH: 你说，医生真的找到花了吗？
fullTextEN: You say, did the doctor really find the flower?
Of course not.

fullTextZH: 你知道为什么公主长大了，
fullTextEN: Do you know why the princess grew up,
right?
Only the king doesn't know,
He's dumb, not smart.
Doctors nowadays are very skilled,
they can do many things,

fullTextZH: 可是他们也不能让小孩马上长大。
fullTextEN: but they also can't make children grow up immediately.
I like this story,

fullTextZH: 因为有的时候我也心急。
fullTextEN: because sometimes I'm also impatient.

fullTextZH: 我也希望小孩快点长大，
fullTextEN: I also hope children grow up quickly,
so he can eat by himself,
and go to the bathroom by himself.
This story tells me,
Don't be impatient,
Some things take time,
Work hard slowly,
There's no other way.
What about you? Are you an impatient person?
Why are you impatient?
Please leave a message and tell me.
See you next time, bye!
